```yaml
name: Downstream Compatibility Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'tests/downstream_compat/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'uv.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/downstream-compat.yaml'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/**'

jobs:
  downstream-compat:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.10', '3.11']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen --dev

      - name: Run downstream compatibility tests
        env:
          CI: true
        run: uv run pytest tests/downstream_compat/ -v --junitxml=pytest-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: downstream-compat (Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
          path: pytest-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          reporter: java-junit
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
